I'm a student who spends way too much free time coding, and I'm always listening to music or looking for new music to listen to. TODO! I originally found this song through one of my dance teachers a couple years ago, but I've never seen the music video until now and it's pretty interesting. That music video definitely fits the song, and the lyrics are very meaningful, but it’s probably not the type of song I’d listen to every day. The bit at the end does get me hyped, though! I’ve only just discovered this song by Paramore, but man, I really wish I found it earlier. It’s gotta be the one thing that’s improving my running pace right now. Yeah I love how energetic the song is, so it's definitely a song I would listen to when exercising. But because of how repetitive it is, I think I would get tired of it if I were just listening to it by itself. The fact that I left it on loop and forgot about it while coding earlier today isn’t helping its chances either; I’m definitely tired of it now. I’ll definitely still use it as a workout song, because its steady rhythm really helps me out. Here's a fun song that I think feels a lot like summer. I love that chorus! The subtle audio distortion when he yells, “We talk too much!” gives it some extra oomph, which is pretty nice. I’m with you 100% on the summer feel, and the music video contributes a lot to it as well. Here’s a pretty chill song I’ve been listening to lately! Ooh, I really like the trumpets(?) near the end that make the song feel a lot more upbeat. Damn, nice find! I never noticed them consciously but they definitely add to the song. And now that I’ve listened to the song more closely (I usually just listen to songs in the background while doing work), I’m finding that the lyrics are pretty nice and the story they tell is lovely. This is one of my favorite Reneé Rapp songs, but I don’t know if this video really matches what the song is like. Hmm yeah, I think the original music video fits the mood better. The song is beautiful, though. I can definitely relate to the theme of sentimentality (nostalgia?) that it has. Yeah her voice sounds so good too, and she expresses that sentiment so well. I haven’t seen the music video yet, so I’ll have to watch that. Oh man, her voice is really something. I don’t often hear songs that go that high and that loud for the chorus. NEW CLARIO! I’ve been hearing about this song recently, but it’s my first time actually listening to it. I really like how it manages to be upbeat yet relaxed at the same time. I totally agree! I love how the bright synths and high-tempo drums combine with the laid back vocals. Well, right now I’m debating whether to listen to this song a lot upfront and risk getting tired of it or be disciplined to avoid that. Yeah when I find a new song I really like, I try to dilute my listening with similar songs or other songs from the same artist to avoid getting sick of it. That's a good idea.
